posts.title: Accepted proposal: omit the type in composite literals
posts.description: Go 1.28 is set to let you drop the type from a composite literal when the compiler can infer it from the place where the value goes.

posts.title: Accepted proposal: grow an existing map with maps.Grow
posts.description: The maps package is getting a Grow function that presizes a map you already have, and maps.Copy will start doing it for you.

posts.title: Partial updates with field masks
posts.description: Keep the value and the update intent in separate fields of a PATCH request.
